name: XAct Tone Solutions (XTS)
dirt_evidence: Precision Overdrive; Atomic Overdrive; Imperial; Tejas Overdriver; XTS Preamp
notes: Walton began by modifying pedals around 2001; by 2006 moved to ground-up designs; by 2009 some PCB/engineering work was subcontracted to Kingdom Amplification. Preserve XTS design identity separately from manufacturing partners.

name: Paul Trombetta Design
dirt_evidence: Donita; Mini-Bone; Bone Machine; Tornita!; later Copper Penny / Rotobone family
notes: Paul Trombetta founded the pedal business in 2005 after earlier repair/modification work. Handwired, point-to-point construction is a documented hallmark. Preserve J. Rockett signature/collaboration products separately from PTD originals.

name: Bob Burt Cabinets & Pedals
dirt_evidence: Bob Burt Overdrive; GR8T Distortion; AH-1 signature distortion
notes: Builder's own timeline documents distribution growth in 2009 and dedicated pedal production space in 2010. Cabinet and pedal businesses coexist.

name: Area 51
notes: Daniel and Anita Albrecht build pedals in-house; local powdercoat/screenprint shops are used for finishing. Exact geography should be verified in later identity pass.

name: Guitarsystems (Paul Lenders / N.E.R.D.)
dirt_evidence: FuzzTool; FuzzTool CS MkII; FuzzTool Junior; Tony's BenderTool and other gain/fuzz tools
notes: Paul Lenders / N.E.R.D. identity preserved as builder record; exact company chronology and geography need a dedicated primary-source pass.

name: Shigemori
dirt_evidence: Ruby Stone; Ruby Stone Premium; Stone Drive Custom; Stone Drive Deluxe; Mighty Stone; Pretone; G.O.T. Bass Drive; later Muse
notes: Japanese boutique line with demonstrable public product trail before its 2010 Effects Database indexing. Do not confuse the pedal maker with unrelated companies named Shigemori.

name: Celestial Effects
dirt_evidence: Taurus; Virgo; Capricorn; Scorpio; Aries; Aquarius; Cancer; Sagittarius and later models
notes: Domenic Mancini proposed the pedal division in 2008 under Thermalogic; brand trademark/use established in 2009. Treat Celestial and Thermalogic as related but distinct entities.

name: Neo-Classic Effects
notes: Steve Mavronis began research in January 2010 and built first self-branded 741 Overdrive prototypes in May 2010. Initial run was extremely small, so preserve prototype/specimen status.
